attributes.title: NASW-MD Ethics Symposium 2027
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Maryland Chapter
attributes.summary:
The Maryland Chapter of the National Association of Social Workers holds its Ethics Symposium, titled Rooted in Justice, on Thursday, April 22, 2027, as a virtual event on Zoom from 8:00 a.m. to 4:14 p.m. Registration is open, and the chapter lists 6 Category I CEUs in ethics; the agenda and fees were not shown on the pages we could read.

A one-day ethics program held online lets social workers cover ethics hours from home or the office. NASW Maryland labels its programs by Maryland CE category, and members receive free or discounted CE at chapter events.

Because the symposium is online, social workers licensed in other states can attend too, but they should confirm that their own board accepts the chapter's CE approval before counting the hours.
